title: Analytics
definition: Tracking user behavior (page views, button clicks, time on page, conversion rates) to make data-driven product decisions. Tools include Google Analytics, Mixpanel, and Amplitude.
simpleExplanation: Tracking how many people clicked the 'Buy Now' button vs how many people abandoned their cart.

basic: What is the core concept of Analytics?
intermediate: How does Analytics impact the overall user experience?
advanced: How do you scale Analytics across a large enterprise application?

answers.question: Define Analytics.
answers.answer: Analytics is a key non-functional requirement for robust frontend systems.
